title: HandLive — shared call objects
description: CALL-01 API 1 and CALL-04 ("Shared data object"): the identifiers and fields shared by the call_event ops and the call notifications, and the call log entry used by call_event/log_sync and call_event/log_new. $defs only; reference them as call_event-common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>.

call-id.description: call_id (0.2): UUIDv7 of the call context A-CALL creates on RINGING or OFFHOOK from IDLE.

number.description: e164 (0.3): normalized with libphonenumber for the SIM's country, else the original string; null when the number is unknown or withheld.

display-name.description: Contact name (PhoneLookup; in a call log entry the CACHED_NAME column when READ_CONTACTS is missing); null when unknown, never an empty string.

sub-id.description: sub_id of the call's SIM; null when it cannot be determined.

entry-id.description: entry_id (0.2) = CallLog.Calls._ID; the provider numbers its rows from 1.

call-type.description: Type of a call log entry, from the TYPE column: 1 incoming, 2 outgoing, 3 missed, 4 voicemail, 5 rejected, 6 blocked, 7 (answered externally) incoming; any other value is skipped. Same values as the call_log_entry.type CHECK of 0.9.3.

entry.description: One call log entry (CALL-04, shared data object entry).

number.description: The NUMBER column, normalized as in CALL-01; empty, or NUMBER_PRESENTATION other than PRESENTATION_ALLOWED → null.

display_name.description: PhoneLookup with READ_CONTACTS, else the CACHED_NAME column; empty → null.

ts.description: The DATE column: when the call started.

sub_id.description: From PHONE_ACCOUNT_COMPONENT_NAME and PHONE_ACCOUNT_ID (API 30+); API 29 or no mapping → null.
